מנאפעה\tadv-b-r1-1125-27.note: manāfiʿu-hu 'his uses/benefits' — manāfiʿ n-f-ʿ with suffix; matches.

מתשאבהה\tadv-b-r1-1260-38.note: mutashābiha 'uniform/mutually resembling' — fem. of mutashābih sh-b-h; matches 'is uniform'.

נחו\tadv-b-r1-1035-14.note: naḥwa 'like/as, in the manner of' — n-ḥ-w; 'נחו קולה' = 'as in His saying'. Base form of the suffixed lemma naḥwahu; defensible.

סבילהא\tadv-q-sabil.note: sabīla-hā 'their road' — sabīl s-b-l with suffix; matches 'walk by their road'.

פאי\tfaw-mouth.evidence: en_phrase 'so whatever multiplicity we find' = fa-ayy(u) 'so whatever/which', particle fa- + ayy; not fā 'mouth'.
פאי\tfaw-mouth.note: 'פאי כת'רה וג'דנאהא' = fa-ayy kathratin wajadnāhā 'so whatever multiplicity we find'; fa-+ayy, not the noun فا 'mouth'.

פאלתכת'ר\tkathura-many.note: fa-al-takaththur 'thus plurality/multiplication' — verbal noun of k-th-r (Form V/II); same root, entry covers increase/multiply. Defensible.

פיהא\tfi.note: fīhā 'in/concerning it' — preposition fī with suffix; matches.

פיקום\tqama-rise.note: fa-yaqūm(u) 'thus it stands/rests' — imperfect of qāma q-w-m; 'fa-yaqūm iʿtiqādunā' = 'thus our belief rests/is established'. Same lemma, idiomatic 'stand/be established'; defensible.

פלא\ttaf-d-45-27.evidence: ja_phrase 'פלא חאג'ה בנא' = fa-lā ḥāja bi-nā 'so we have no need'; פלא = fa-lā (conjunction fa- + negative lā), not the verb taḫāfuhum 'you fear them' (kh-w-f). Zero semantic overlap.
פלא\ttaf-d-45-27.note: Surface is פ (fa-) + לא; mis-stuffed into the kh-w-f verb variant list.

פן\tadv-b-r1-270-1.evidence: תהלים/משלי כה:טז 'פן תשבענו והקאתו' — embedded Hebrew פֶּן 'lest'; not the Hebrew connective כֵּן 'so/thus/yes' that the entry lemma (כן) carries.
פן\tadv-b-r1-270-1.note: Embedded biblical Hebrew (Prov 25:16). Entry lemma כן is the wrong Hebrew word; surface is פן.

fix.corrected_gloss_en: maker, craftsman, artisan; (here) the Maker (of the world)

צאנע\tadv-b-r1-2835-42.evidence: ja_phrase 'אן יכון ללעאלם צאנע' = 'the world must have a Maker' — singular ṣāniʿ 'maker, craftsman'; the entry lemma אלצנאע is the PLURAL al-ṣunnāʿ 'the craftsmen', glossed plural. Singular surface mis-pointed at plural lemma.
צאנע\tadv-b-r1-2835-42.note: Standard kalām ṣāniʿ al-ʿālam. Same root as the plural lemma but wrong (plural) base form/gloss.

אכ'ר\takhar-other.evidence: 'ולא אכ'ר' = 'nor end' is contextually āḫir 'last/end'; entry gloss explicitly includes '(al-ākhir) the last, the latter', which covers the end sense, so defensible.

אלוה\tadv-b-r1-270-42.evidence: היש אלוה מבלעדי — embedded Hebrew אֱלוֹהַּ 'God'; entry already correctly marked Hebrew quote = God.

אלחק\thaqq-right-truth.evidence: 'פאלואחד אלחק' = 'the True One' — al-ḥaqq 'the True/Real'; covered by the truth/right sense.

ואלצנאעאת\tsinaʿa-craft.evidence: 'ואלעלום ואלצנאעאת' = 'the sciences and the crafts' — plural of ṣināʿa, base lemma is the singular; inflected plural pointing at own base is fine.

חפץ\thifz-charge.evidence: קהלת ג:א 'לכל זמן ועת לכל חפץ תחת השמים' — embedded Hebrew חֵפֶץ 'purpose, matter, desire'; mis-glossed as Arabic ḥifẓ 'guarding/keeping' (ḥ-f-ẓ).
חפץ\thifz-charge.note: Ecclesiastes 3:1 is fully Hebrew here; the Arabic ḥifẓ entry is a false homograph.

ירא\ttaf-d-630-34.evidence: יונה א:ט — 'ואת ה' אלהי השמים אני ירא אשר עשה את הים ואת היבשה'; phrase in text reads 'ה' אלהי השמים אני ירא אשר עשה את הים'
ירא\ttaf-d-630-34.note: Embedded biblical Hebrew quote (Jonah 1:9), not the Arabic passive yurā 'it is seen'.

כתקדם\ttaqaddama-advance.evidence: taqaddama includes 'to take precedence / be prior', matching en 'is prior'

מדבר\tadv-heb-midbar.evidence: Context 'תדביר מדבר ואחד' = 'the governance (tadbīr) of a single Director (mudabbir)'; the cognate noun tadbīr is right beside it. This is Arabic mudabbir (d-b-r, II), not Hebrew midbar 'wilderness' (Ps 102:7).
מדבר\tadv-heb-midbar.note: Mis-attributed to a Hebrew lemma; the surface is the Arabic active participle mudabbir, paired with tadbīr in the same phrase.

מקאם\ttaf-h-462-57.note: Same lemma/root maqām; sense is positional/adverbial 'in place of', not 'dwelling'.

פאלצ'עיף\tadv-b-r1-315-34.evidence: Surface al-ḍaʿīf 'the weak (one)' is the adjective from ḍaʿufa; pointing at its own ḍ-ʿ-f base lemma is fine.

ראם\ttaf-d-360-34.evidence: r-w-m rāma = to seek/desire/aim at; en 'desires' is within this sense range.

רצ'י\tadv-radiya.evidence: raḍiya allāh ʿanhu = 'may God be pleased with him'; correct sense.

תהיא\tadv-tahayyu.note: Same root h-y-ʔ; entry glosses the maṣdar (noun) but surface is the form-V verb tahayyaʔa 'came to be/became disposed'.
